~news: No march was taken today, so no raid came near. Across the land, every village held steady: Hartbury kept its 21 souls and 17 houses, Wellstead its 19 souls and 10 houses, Thornmoor its 19 souls and 8 houses, and the rest held their numbers and coin as given. No village grew or shrank sharply; all remained in balance. If you are a chief, you may feel calm, but remember that each village is watching, and tomorrow’s change could be just as quiet—or sharper than today. If you ever need to raise a company, look at the purse of Hartbury, the largest of its kind, and the steady hands of its neighbors who still hold 20 or more souls. For now, peace holds firm, and the day ends without debt or gain beyond what you already carry.
